scope.research_question: Can point-in-time machine-learning ranks identify U.S.-traded stocks with superior next-month CAPM alpha, FF5-plus-momentum alpha, long net opportunity, or short net opportunity?

inputs.diagnostic_model_rule: cam_free and news_free reuse the validation-selected XGBoost objective and operating policy; cam_only uses the Elastic Net benchmark. Diagnostics cover validation and historical-test months but cannot select the primary model.

target_interpretation.long_net: next-holding-period cash-excess return minus a selector-level round-trip cost shadow
target_interpretation.short_net: negative next-holding-period cash-excess return minus a selector-level round-trip cost shadow and monthly modeled borrow cost

chronology.fit_rule: A row may enter a fit only when label_available_date is no later than the forecast month's signal_date.
chronology.forecast_rule: Every forecast is generated from the most recent scheduled fit available at signal close.

preprocessing.continuous_firm: monthly 1/99 clipping, centered cross-sectional rank, missing value zero, explicit missing indicator
preprocessing.binary_firm: retain 0/1, missing value zero, explicit missing indicator
preprocessing.categorical_firm: frozen vocabulary with explicit unknown state
preprocessing.aggregate_state: strictly-past expanding z-score clipped to [-5,5], missing value zero, explicit missing indicator

continuous_rank.xgboost: reg:pseudohubererror on the centered monthly target rank
continuous_rank.neural_network: smooth-L1 loss on the centered monthly target rank

xgboost.academic_depth_rationale: Gu-Kelly-Xiu and closely aligned cross-sectional equity implementations use shallow boosted trees with depth 1-3; V5 used depth 3 and V5.1 used depth 2-3.

causal_tuning.metric: equal-month mean cross-sectional Spearman rank IC
causal_tuning.selection: At a scheduled retune, fit every profile before the trailing 12 label-available months, score those months, select highest mean monthly rank IC, and refit the selected profile using all label-available rows. Between retunes reuse the selected profile.
causal_tuning.profile_tie_break: within 0.002 mean IC prefer the simpler profile, then profile_id
causal_tuning.family_candidate_selection: using 2020-2023 only, maximize mean rank IC; within 0.002 prefer continuous-rank, annual refit, annual retune, expanding history, then candidate_id

elastic_net.selection_metric: equal-month mean cross-sectional Spearman rank IC

dynamic_ensemble.quality: exponentially weighted mean of strictly prior monthly rank IC, floored at zero

also_report: median and standard deviation of monthly IC
economic-target top-decile mean and top-minus-bottom spread
XGBoost gain and Elastic Net coefficient summaries

identity_binds: candidate, profile, seed, train cutoff, and forecast months
checkpointing.identity_mismatch: fail closed into a new output lineage
